# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass
- [ ] Accessibility and keyboard behaviour were considered
- [ ] Light, Night and System modes were considered where applicable
- [ ] Reduced-motion behaviour was considered where applicable
- [ ] Documentation was updated where required

## Child safety and content integrity

- [ ] No child names, photographs, videos or private family data were added
- [ ] No media upload or gallery functionality was introduced
- [ ] School facts and public claims are verified or clearly marked unresolved

## Review notes

Call out risks, deferred work and any manual verification needed.
